Select your dice
Tap the dice in the storage to move them to the selection zone.
Adjust your selection
If you want to remove a die, tap it in the selection zone to return it.
Start game
When you are ready, tap “Start game” to begin.
Select cards
Tap cards to build your deck (30–40). At the top left you can see how many cards you have and at the top right how many you have selected.
Create your deck
Tap Create, enter a name, and confirm to save your deck.
Manage decks
Use Load or Delete to manage your saved decks.
Accept
Goals and game loop
The goal of the game is to capture as many fish as possible through strategic dice placement.
Roll a die
To start the game you must roll a die. Select a die to roll.
Place the die
Select the space in the fishing zone where you want to place the die.
Reveal the card
When you place a die on a card, it flips and can trigger abilities and show capture requirements. To see details, long-press the card.
Capture attempt
We will attempt to capture the card. Roll a new die and place it on a card that already has a die. If you meet the capture condition the card is yours; otherwise you must select a die to discard.
Release a card
You can release a card to the fishing zone to reuse its abilities. Click the card you want to release.
Choose where to release
You can select where in the fishing zone to release the card.
Tides
The tide activates if a die rolls 1 and drags all cards upward; dice that leave the game due to the tide will be lost. To pass the tutorial just tap the screen to continue.
